 DeviceChain · Installing · kind-devicechain
 Help · Install progress
 
 l           logs
 Ctrl+C      stop
 ?/F1        help
 
 The run goes on while help is open: help never pauses or
 stops it. Ctrl+C stops the run safely and waits for it to
 settle; a second Ctrl+C exits at once. Esc never stops it.
 Nothing is rolled back. The overall bar counts finished
 stages, never a percentage, and a stage's bar is full only
 once the stage has finished. Work with no known total
 shows that it is working, never a number. l opens the log
 … 2 lines below
 Esc close help  ↑/↓ scroll  Ctrl+C stop
